player_prompt.intro:
Iwe ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} michezo ya Indian Poker.
- Dheki ya kadi 52; unona kadi ya mupinzani chete.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kila raundi, {max_rounds} raundi(s) kwa jumla.
- Zvitendo zvinokubalika: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ndiyo nambari chanya isiyozidi kiasi chako cha chip.)
- Kadi yenye thamani yakanyanya inoshinda poti pa kupambwa.

Kadi ya mupinzani wako ndi: {card}
